title: A Rainy Week
text:
It is a rainy week in our town. On Monday it rains all day. The streets are wet and cold.

On Friday the sky is blue. The sun is hot. We go to the beach with our friends.

questions.text: What is the weather like on Monday?
Where do the people go on Friday?
How do the people probably feel on Friday?
Why are the streets wet on Monday?

vocabulary.definition: roads in a town with houses and shops
a sandy place next to the sea

paragraph_translations: To deszczowy tydzień w naszym mieście. W poniedziałek pada cały dzień. Ulice są mokre i zimne.
W piątek niebo jest niebieskie. Słońce jest gorące. Idziemy na plażę z przyjaciółmi.
